Real drawn interior depth, diffuse light, muted readable detail, full bleed opaque illustration.

Make ONE production-ready transparent skeletal animation LAYER ATLAS from the supplied full-body infected alien soldier. NO borders, NO lines, NO labels, NO text, NO background, no ground shadows. Truly transparent empty canvas between parts. Every cell precisely same full-character scale and alignment.
